comparisons.independentReasoning: Domain a!=3. Factor (a^2-9)/(a-3)=a+3 on original domain; subtract a to get3. At a=-2 original fraction=(-5)/(-5)=1, minus(-2)=3.
x^2-4=(x-2)(x+2) must not be zero, so both x=2 and x=-2 are excluded. Cancelling x+2 does not restore x=-2.
Principal sqrt(x^2)=abs(x)=7. Given x>0 selects x=7; negative root excluded.
Let original price P>0. After a20% rise,1.2P=360 so P=300. Increase=360-300=60 hryvnias, also .2*300=60.
Domain b!=4. Factor fraction=(b-4)(b+4)/(b-4)=b+4,subtract b=4. At b=-1 original fraction=(-15)/(-5)=3,minus(-1)=4.
x^2-9=(x-3)(x+3) must be nonzero,so x!=3 and x!=-3. Cancellation retains both original exclusions.
Let original price P. After25% decrease .75P=450 givesP=600. Decrease=600-450=150 hryvnias;also .25*600=150.

remainingMethodologyNotes: Six final/delayed pairs preserve mathematical procedure and differ by values/signs. Unseen parallel forms can provide narrow retention evidence; stronger transfer needs richer changed contexts and combined constraints.
Avoid exposing assessment prompts or solutions in reusable practice before first scheduled assessment; record first unseen attempt separately from repeats.
Ten EASY recommendations from blind review remain expert judgement; reverse-percent tasks appropriately MEDIUM.
Percent teaching must distinguish original base from final price. Suggested fresh example: price after20% rise is420; original420/1.2=350 and increase70. Use distinct figures from actual bank.
